declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.SignedRootTrace.squareTrace_eq_real
declarations.type:

    ∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ),
      GRWTSK.Polynomial.SignedRootTrace.squareTrace nodes weight p =
        ↑(∑ z ∈ nodes, weight z * Polynomial.eval z.re p ^ 2)

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.SignedRootTrace.exists_pair_test
declarations.type:

      z ∈ nodes →
        z.im ≠ 0 →
          ∃ p,
            p.degree < ↑nodes.card ∧
              GRWTSK.Polynomial.SignedRootTrace.squareTrace nodes weight p = -↑(weight z + weight ((starRingEnd ℂ) z))

  z ∈ nodes →
    (starRingEnd ℂ) z ∈ nodes →
      z.im ≠ 0 →
        ∀ {p : Polynomial ℝ},
          (∀ w ∈ nodes, Polynomial.eval₂ Complex.ofRealHom w p = GRWTSK.Polynomial.SignedRootTrace.pairValues z w) →

declarations.type:

    ∀ (weight : ℂ → ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ nodes, weight ((starRingEnd ℂ) z) = weight z) →
        ∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ), (GRWTSK.Polynomial.SignedRootTrace.squareTrace nodes weight p).im = 0

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.SignedRootTrace.squareTrace_nonneg_iff_real
declarations.type:
∀ {nodes : Finset ℂ},
  (∀ z ∈ nodes, (starRingEnd ℂ) z ∈ nodes) →
    ∀ {weight : ℂ → ℝ},
      (∀ z ∈ nodes, 0 < weight z) →
        ((∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ),
            p.degree < ↑nodes.card → 0 ≤ (GRWTSK.Polynomial.SignedRootTrace.squareTrace nodes weight p).re) ↔
          ∀ z ∈ nodes, z.im = 0)

                (2 * ↑A) (GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceWeight r.secondDerivative ↑A) t)

                  ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * F (Real.log ↑n) +

declarations.type:
∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (A t : ℝ),
  GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceWeight g A t =
    Real.exp (-t / 2) *
      (deriv (GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A) t -
        GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A t / 2)

declarations.type:

        if Real.log ↑n ≤ t then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n else 0

declarations.name: GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.PrimePowerDescent.source_arithmetic_representation_of_correlation_conditions
declarations.type:
∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (A : ℝ),
  1 ≤ A →
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A) →
      GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A (2 * A) = 0 →
        (∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..2 * A, Real.exp (t / 2) * GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A t) +
              ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..2 * A,
                Real.exp (-t / 2) * GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A t =
            0 →
          GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceQuadraticValue g A =
            GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.analyticCorrection g A +
              2 * GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.signedPairing g A

declarations.name: GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.PrimePowerDescent.chebyshev_prime_power_ibp_of_upper_zero
declarations.type:
∀ (b : ℝ),
  GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.lowerEndpoint ≤ b →
    ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 1 F →
        F b = 0 →
          ∫ (t : ℝ) in GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.lowerEndpoint..b,
              GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.chebyshevError (Real.exp t) * deriv F t =
            -∑
                    n ∈
                      GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.PrimePowerDescent.primePowerInventory
                        b,
                    ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * F (Real.log ↑n) +
                2 * F GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.lowerEndpoint +
              ∫ (t : ℝ) in GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.lowerEndpoint..b, Real.exp t * F t

declarations.name: GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.PrimePowerDescent.source_signed_pairing_ibp
declarations.type:
∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (A : ℝ),
  1 ≤ A →
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A) →
      GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.signedPairing g A =
        GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.chebyshevError (Real.exp (2 * A)) *
                GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.PrimePowerDescent.exponentialTest
                  (GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A) (2 * A) -
              ∑
                n ∈
                  GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.PrimePowerDescent.primePowerInventory
                    (2 * A),
                ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n *
                  GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.PrimePowerDescent.exponentialTest
                    (GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A) (Real.log ↑n) +
            2 *
              GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.PrimePowerDescent.exponentialTest
                (GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A)
                GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.lowerEndpoint +
          ∫ (t : ℝ) in GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.lowerEndpoint..2 * A,
            Real.exp t *
              GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.PrimePowerDescent.exponentialTest
                (GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.SourcePairing.sourceCorrelation g A) t

declarations.name: GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.BridgeAdmissibility.realArithmeticForm.eq_1

        GRWTSK.SpectralUnificationOfComputabilityAndAlgebraicSymmetry.BridgeAdmissibility.realPoleContribution f -
      2 *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 ⌊Real.exp (2 * A)⌋₊ with ↑n < Real.exp (2 * A),
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / √↑n * ∫ (x : ℝ), f x * f (x - Real.log ↑n)

declarations.name: ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.block_energy_exact
declarations.type:
∀ (B : Finset ℕ),
  (∀ p ∈ B, Nat.Prime p) →
    ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ u < 0, f u = 0) →
        ∀ (T : ℝ),
          (∀ U ∈ B.powerset,
              ∀ V ∈ B.powerset,
                MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                  (fun u =>
                    ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.shift
                        (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeDelay (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeProduct U)) f u *
                      ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.shift
                        (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeDelay (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeProduct V)) f u)
                  (Set.Icc 0 T) MeasureTheory.volume) →
            ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 T,
                ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.cascade ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeWeight ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeDelay
                    B.toList f u ^
                  2 =
              ∑ U ∈ B.powerset,
                ∑ V ∈ B.powerset,
                  ↑(ArithmeticFunction.moebius (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeProduct U)) *
                        ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeWeight (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeProduct U) *
                      (↑(ArithmeticFunction.moebius (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeProduct V)) *
                        ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeWeight (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeProduct V)) *
                    ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 T,
                      ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.shift
                          (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeDelay (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeProduct U)) f u *
                        ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.shift
                          (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeDelay (ASBNP04.FiniteProduct.primeProduct V)) f u

{b T : ℝ} →
  {parent : HSSCP04.SignedCharts.Chart b T} →
    {P : Sort u} →
      {childWidth childTime : ℝ} →
        {child_width_valid : HSSCP04.PinnedShellWidth childWidth} →
          {child_time_valid : childWidth ≤ childTime} →
            {child : HSSCP04.SignedCharts.Chart childWidth childTime} →
              {lower_rank : HSSCP04.LowerRank child.rank parent.rank} →
                {scale : ℝ} →
                  {scale_positive : 0 < scale} →
                    {offset : ℝ} →
                      {width_normalized : childWidth = scale * b} →
                        {time_normalized : childTime = scale * T + offset} →
                          {amplitude : ℝ} →
                            {residualMature residualHorizon : ℝ → ℝ} →
                              {residual_mature_memLp : MeasureTheory.MemLp residualMature 2 MeasureTheory.volume} →
                                {residual_horizon_memLp : MeasureTheory.MemLp residualHorizon 2 MeasureTheory.volume} →
                                  {mature_reconstruction :
                                      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (T - b) T,
                                        HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket parent u =
                                          amplitude * HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket child (scale * u + offset) +
                                            residualMature u} →
                                    {horizon_reconstruction :
                                        ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (T - b) T,
                                          HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket parent u =
                                            amplitude * HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket child (scale * u + offset) +
                                              residualHorizon u} →
                                      {pulled_integrable :
                                          MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                            (fun u =>
                                              (amplitude *
                                                  (HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket child (scale * u + offset) +
                                                    HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket child (scale * u + offset))) ^
                                                2)
                                            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc (T - b) T))} →
                                        {transport : ℝ} →
                                          {transport_nonnegative : 0 ≤ transport} →
                                            {transport_bound :
                                                ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (T - b) T,
                                                    (amplitude *
                                                        (HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket child (scale * u + offset) +
                                                          HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket child
                                                            (scale * u + offset))) ^
                                                      2 ≤
                                                  transport * HSSCP04.SignedCharts.packetEnergy child} →
                                              {residualBudget : ℝ} →
                                                {residual_budget_nonnegative : 0 ≤ residualBudget} →
                                                  {residual_bound :
                                                      ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (T - b) T,

                                                        residualBudget} →
                                                    {childWidth' childTime' : ℝ} →
                                                      {child_width_valid' : HSSCP04.PinnedShellWidth childWidth'} →
                                                        {child_time_valid' : childWidth' ≤ childTime'} →
                                                          {child' : HSSCP04.SignedCharts.Chart childWidth' childTime'} →
                                                            {lower_rank' : HSSCP04.LowerRank child'.rank parent.rank} →
                                                              {scale' : ℝ} →
                                                                {scale_positive' : 0 < scale'} →
                                                                  {offset' : ℝ} →
                                                                    {width_normalized' : childWidth' = scale' * b} →
                                                                      {time_normalized' :
                                                                          childTime' = scale' * T + offset'} →
                                                                        {amplitude' : ℝ} →
                                                                          {residualMature' residualHorizon' : ℝ → ℝ} →
                                                                            {residual_mature_memLp' :
                                                                                MeasureTheory.MemLp residualMature' 2
                                                                                  MeasureTheory.volume} →
                                                                              {residual_horizon_memLp' :
                                                                                  MeasureTheory.MemLp residualHorizon' 2
                                                                                    MeasureTheory.volume} →
                                                                                {mature_reconstruction' :
                                                                                    ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (T - b) T,
                                                                                      HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket
                                                                                          parent u =
                                                                                        amplitude' *
                                                                                            HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket
                                                                                              child'
                                                                                              (scale' * u + offset') +
                                                                                          residualMature' u} →
                                                                                  {horizon_reconstruction' :
                                                                                      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (T - b) T,
                                                                                        HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket
                                                                                            parent u =
                                                                                          amplitude' *
                                                                                              HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket
                                                                                                child'
                                                                                                (scale' * u + offset') +
                                                                                            residualHorizon' u} →
                                                                                    {pulled_integrable' :
                                                                                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                                                          (fun u =>
                                                                                            (amplitude' *
                                                                                                (HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket
                                                                                                    child'
                                                                                                    (scale' * u +
                                                                                                      offset') +
                                                                                                  HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket
                                                                                                    child'
                                                                                                    (scale' * u +
                                                                                                      offset'))) ^
                                                                                              2)
                                                                                          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict
                                                                                            (Set.Icc (T - b) T))} →
                                                                                      {transport' : ℝ} →
                                                                                        {transport_nonnegative' :
                                                                                            0 ≤ transport'} →
                                                                                          {transport_bound' :
                                                                                              ∫ (u : ℝ) in
                                                                                                  Set.Icc (T - b) T,
                                                                                                  (amplitude' *
                                                                                                      (HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket
                                                                                                          child'
                                                                                                          (scale' * u +
                                                                                                            offset') +
                                                                                                        HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket
                                                                                                          child'
                                                                                                          (scale' * u +
                                                                                                            offset'))) ^
                                                                                                    2 ≤
                                                                                                transport' *
                                                                                                  HSSCP04.SignedCharts.packetEnergy
                                                                                                    child'} →
                                                                                            {residualBudget' : ℝ} →
                                                                                              {residual_budget_nonnegative' :
                                                                                                  0 ≤ residualBudget'} →
                                                                                                {residual_bound' :
                                                                                                    ∫ (u : ℝ) in
                                                                                                        Set.Icc (T - b)
                                                                                                          T,
                                                                                                        (residualMature'
                                                                                                              u +
                                                                                                            residualHorizon'
                                                                                                              u) ^
                                                                                                          2 ≤

declarations.type:
∀ {b T : ℝ} {parent : HSSCP04.SignedCharts.Chart b T} (childWidth childTime : ℝ)
  (child_width_valid : HSSCP04.PinnedShellWidth childWidth) (child_time_valid : childWidth ≤ childTime)
  (child : HSSCP04.SignedCharts.Chart childWidth childTime) (lower_rank : HSSCP04.LowerRank child.rank parent.rank)
  (scale : ℝ) (scale_positive : 0 < scale) (offset : ℝ) (width_normalized : childWidth = scale * b)
  (time_normalized : childTime = scale * T + offset) (amplitude : ℝ) (residualMature residualHorizon : ℝ → ℝ)
  (residual_mature_memLp : MeasureTheory.MemLp residualMature 2 MeasureTheory.volume)
  (residual_horizon_memLp : MeasureTheory.MemLp residualHorizon 2 MeasureTheory.volume)
  (mature_reconstruction :
    ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (T - b) T,
      HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket parent u =
        amplitude * HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket child (scale * u + offset) + residualMature u)
  (horizon_reconstruction :
    ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (T - b) T,
      HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket parent u =
        amplitude * HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket child (scale * u + offset) + residualHorizon u)
  (pulled_integrable :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun u =>
        (amplitude *
            (HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket child (scale * u + offset) +
              HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket child (scale * u + offset))) ^
          2)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc (T - b) T)))
  (transport : ℝ) (transport_nonnegative : 0 ≤ transport)
  (transport_bound :
    ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (T - b) T,
        (amplitude *
            (HSSCP04.SignedCharts.maturePacket child (scale * u + offset) +
              HSSCP04.SignedCharts.horizonPacket child (scale * u + offset))) ^
          2 ≤
      transport * HSSCP04.SignedCharts.packetEnergy child)
  (residualBudget : ℝ) (residual_budget_nonnegative : 0 ≤ residualBudget)
  (residual_bound : ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (T - b) T, (residualMature u + residualHorizon u) ^ 2 ≤ residualBudget),
  sizeOf

declarations.name: PPNCP04.controller_square_root_cost_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {T η κ : ℝ} (controller : PPNCP04.ActualDiagnostics.AdmissibleController T η),
  0 ≤ κ →
    ∑ j, PPNCP04.Cost.blockCost κ (PPNCP04.Obstruction.harmonicMass (controller.blocks j)) ≤
      PPNCP04.Cost.massCostConstant κ η * PPNCP04.Obstruction.harmonicMass (PPNCP04.primeInventory T) + (2 * κ * √η + η)

declarations.name: PPNCP04.controller_cost_log_budget
declarations.type:

  0 ≤ κ →
    PPNCP04.Obstruction.harmonicMass (PPNCP04.primeInventory T) ≤ C_M * Real.log (2 + T) →
      ∑ j, PPNCP04.Cost.blockCost κ (PPNCP04.Obstruction.harmonicMass (controller.blocks j)) ≤
        PPNCP04.Cost.massCostConstant κ η * C_M * Real.log (2 + T) + (2 * κ * √η + η)

declarations.name: PPNCP04.controller_costs_have_log_budget
declarations.type:
∀ (κ η : ℝ),
  0 ≤ κ →
    0 < η →
      ∃ d H,
        0 ≤ d ∧
          0 ≤ H ∧
            ∀ (T : ℝ) (controller : PPNCP04.ActualDiagnostics.AdmissibleController T η),
              ∑ j, PPNCP04.Cost.blockCost κ (PPNCP04.Obstruction.harmonicMass (controller.blocks j)) ≤
                d * Real.log (2 + T) + H

declarations.name: EulerP04RH.ASRefutation.exists_actual_failed_AS_step
declarations.type:
∀ (A : PPNCP04.ReserveFunctional) (C q η : ℝ),
  0 ≤ C →
    0 ≤ q →

        ∃ T P B,

            Real.exp (C * PPNCP04.harmonicMass B) * PPNCP04.potential A P T + C * PPNCP04.harmonicMass B * (1 + T) ^ q <
              PPNCP04.potential A (P ∪ B) T

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Analysis.Convolution.FirstMomentConvolution.first_moment_convolution_ae
declarations.type:
∀ {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable g MeasureTheory.volume →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => x * f x) MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => x * g x) MeasureTheory.volume →
          (fun t =>
              t *
                MeasureTheory.convolution f g (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume
                  t) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
            fun t =>
            MeasureTheory.convolution (fun x => x * f x) g (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume t +
              MeasureTheory.convolution f (fun x => x * g x) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume t

declarations.type:
∀ {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable g MeasureTheory.volume →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => x * f x) MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => x * g x) MeasureTheory.volume →
          ∫ (t : ℝ), t * MeasureTheory.convolution f g (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume t =
            ((∫ (x : ℝ), x * f x) * ∫ (x : ℝ), g x) + (∫ (x : ℝ), f x) * ∫ (x : ℝ), x * g x

declarations.type:

  GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadraticTrace a t c₀ c₁ c₂ =
    4 * c₀ ^ 2 + 4 * (t ^ 2 - a ^ 2) * (c₁ ^ 2 + 2 * c₀ * c₂) + 4 * (t ^ 4 - 6 * a ^ 2 * t ^ 2 + a ^ 4) * c₂ ^ 2

  (x x_1 : ℕ),
  GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.ParentTraceDictionary.expand nodes x x_1 =
    match x, x_1 with
    | 0, slot => do
      let node ← nodes[slot]?
      match node.2 with
        | none => if node.1 = 0 then some [] else none
        | some val => none
    | fuel.succ, slot => do

          let parentNode ← nodes[parent]?

              let initial ← GRWTSK.Combinatorics.DirectedGraph.ParentTraceDictionary.expand nodes fuel parent
              some (initial ++ [edge])
            else none

declarations.type:
∀ (g : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ) (J : ℕ) (S C : ℝ),
  0 ≤ S →
    0 ≤ C →
      (∀ i ≤ J + MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower,
          S * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 i) g + (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower i) g) ≤
            C) →
        S * ∫ (t : ℝ), ‖t‖ ^ J * ‖(FourierTransform.fourier g) t‖ ≤
          (2 ^ MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower * ∫ (t : ℝ), (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-↑MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower)) *
            (2 ^ 0 * (0 + 1) *
                  (2 ^ MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower *
                    ∫ (t : ℝ), (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-↑MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower)) *
                C +
              2 ^ (J + MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower) * (↑J + ↑MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower + 1) *
                  (2 ^ MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower *
                    ∫ (t : ℝ), (1 + ‖t‖) ^ (-↑MeasureTheory.volume.integrablePower)) *
                C)

          GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.NormalizedGaussian.gaussianMellinProfile (R * Real.exp (∑ i, a i * y i)) =
        ∫ (t : ℝ),
          (∏ i, W i (y i) * GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianCoupledSeparation.logPhase t (a i * y i)) *
            (GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianLogWindow.gaussianJointDensity V hV R) t

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianCoupledSeparation.gaussian_coupled_family
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (W : ι → ℝ → ℂ) (a M : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ M i) →
    (∀ (i : ι) (y : ℝ), W i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i) →
      ∃ V,
        ∃ (hV : HasCompactSupport ⇑V),
          (∀ (R : ℝ),
              0 < R →
                ∀ (y : ι → ℝ),
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun t =>
                        (∏ i,
                            W i (y i) *
                              GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianCoupledSeparation.logPhase t (a i * y i)) *
                          (GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianLogWindow.gaussianJointDensity V hV R) t)
                      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                    (∏ i, W i (y i)) *
                        GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.NormalizedGaussian.gaussianMellinProfile
                          (R * Real.exp (∑ i, a i * y i)) =
                      ∫ (t : ℝ),
                        (∏ i,
                            W i (y i) *
                              GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianCoupledSeparation.logPhase t (a i * y i)) *
                          (GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianLogWindow.gaussianJointDensity V hV R) t) ∧
            ∀ (A : ℝ) (J : ℕ),
              ∃ C,
                0 < C ∧
                  ∀ (R : ℝ),
                    0 < R →
                      MeasureTheory.Integrable
                          (fun t =>
                            (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J *
                              ‖(GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianLogWindow.gaussianJointDensity V hV R) t‖)
                          MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                        ∫ (t : ℝ),
                            (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J *
                              ‖(GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianLogWindow.gaussianJointDensity V hV R) t‖ ≤
                          C * R ^ (-A)

declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (W : ι → ℝ → ℂ) (M : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ M i) →
    (∀ (i : ι) (y : ℝ), W i (Real.exp y) ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i) →
      ∃ V,
        ∃ (hV : HasCompactSupport ⇑V),
          (∀ (R : ℝ),
              0 < R →
                ∀ (x : ℝ),
                  0 < x →
                    ∀ (q : ι → ℝ),
                      (∀ (i : ι), 0 < q i) →
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                            (fun t =>
                              (GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.CompactGaussianWindow.rootWeight
                                    (GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianAnnularSeparation.logPhaseTwist
                                      GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianWindowSeminorms.gaussianFixedWindow t)
                                    x *
                                  ∏ i,
                                    W i (q i) *
                                      GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianCoupledSeparation.logPhase (-t)
                                        (Real.log (q i))) *
                                (GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianLogWindow.gaussianJointDensity V hV R) t)
                            MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                          (GRWTSK.Analysis.PartitionOfUnity.DyadicAnnulus.dyadicAnnulus x * ∏ i, W i (q i)) *
                              GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.NormalizedGaussian.gaussianMellinProfile
                                (R * x / ∏ i, q i) =
                            ∫ (t : ℝ),
                              (GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.CompactGaussianWindow.rootWeight
                                    (GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianAnnularSeparation.logPhaseTwist
                                      GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianWindowSeminorms.gaussianFixedWindow t)
                                    x *
                                  ∏ i,
                                    W i (q i) *
                                      GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianCoupledSeparation.logPhase (-t)
                                        (Real.log (q i))) *
                                (GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianLogWindow.gaussianJointDensity V hV R) t) ∧
            ∀ (A : ℝ) (J : ℕ),
              ∃ C,
                0 < C ∧
                  ∀ (R : ℝ),
                    0 < R →
                      MeasureTheory.Integrable
                          (fun t =>
                            (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J *
                              ‖(GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianLogWindow.gaussianJointDensity V hV R) t‖)
                          MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                        ∫ (t : ℝ),
                            (1 + ‖t‖) ^ J *
                              ‖(GRWTSK.Analysis.MellinTransform.GaussianLogWindow.gaussianJointDensity V hV R) t‖ ≤
                          C * R ^ (-A)

declarations.type:
∀ {S : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing S] [inst_1 : IsDedekindDomain S] [inst_2 : Module.Free ℤ S] [Module.Finite ℤ S]
  (I J H : Ideal S),
  I ≠ 0 →
    J ≠ 0 →
      H ≠ 0 →
        ↑(Ideal.absNorm I) ≤ ↑(Ideal.absNorm I) * ↑(Ideal.absNorm J) ^ 3 * ↑(Ideal.absNorm H) ^ 3 ∧
          ↑(Ideal.absNorm J) ≤ ↑(Ideal.absNorm I) * ↑(Ideal.absNorm J) ^ 3 * ↑(Ideal.absNorm H) ^ 3 ∧
            ↑(Ideal.absNorm H) ≤ ↑(Ideal.absNorm I) * ↑(Ideal.absNorm J) ^ 3 * ↑(Ideal.absNorm H) ^ 3

declarations.type:

  HasCompactSupport W →
    ∀ (X : ℝ),
      0 < X →
        ∀ (F : Ideal S × Ideal S × Ideal S → ℂ),
          (∀ (I J H : Ideal S), I = 0 ∨ J = 0 ∨ H = 0 → F (I, J, H) = 0) →
            (∀ (I J H : Ideal S),
                W (↑(Ideal.absNorm I) * ↑(Ideal.absNorm J) ^ 3 * ↑(Ideal.absNorm H) ^ 3 / X) = 0 → F (I, J, H) = 0) →

                some GRWTSK.PartialSumOrdering.CertificateRejection.labelsNotDistinctNonzero

            ∀ (m : ℝ),

                    2 ^ k ≤ m / 2000 ^ 2 →

                              (GRWTSK.ZModIndependentSelection.eventProbability fun ω => energy ω χ < 2 * 2 ^ k) ≤
                                1 / ↑S.card ^ 9) →
                        (GRWTSK.ZModExpectedLayers.mean fun ω =>
                            ↑(GRWTSK.FiniteExponentialLayers.dyadicBand (energy ω) k).card) ≤
                          10000 * ↑p * √(2 ^ k) / (↑S.card * √m)
